what: National life tables (by WorldPop age band) and fertility schedules, for machine 4's life expectancy, TFR, CBR and CDR
source: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2024). World Population Prospects 2024. Via the wpp2024 R package 1.1-3 (2024-11-26), https://github.com/PPgp/wpp2024
life_table: single-year mx -> q = m/(1+(1-a)m), a = 0.5, a0 Andreev & Kingkade 2015 (both sexes: mean of the women's and men's rule), open 100+ lives l/m; aggregated to bands
population: pop: WPP 2024's national population of that sex (popAge1dt summed over ages to 2023, popproj1dt medium from 2024), in people
check: largest difference from WPP's own e0: 0.050 years (SOM 2011 F: 33.701 against WPP's 33.651)
